judge.rationale: All answers share PTPRC exon-4 splicing and the CD45RA-to-CD45RO switch, and three additionally share HNRNPLL, but answer D substitutes a PTBP1–hnRNP L–SFPQ–GSK3/PI3K–Akt mechanism and the answers use many nonshared state markers, so more than half of the complete molecular content differs and the shared-minority ceiling limits the score to 4.
